affected_boundaries: unknown-outcome creation retry to typed review dispatch

observed_behavior: An original STARTED creation with unknown host outcome could not be retried after its plan became review-ready, even with a safe original idle campaign pair.
expected_behavior: A directly authorized retry can supersede that original with one review-only action on the safe pair while retaining the original receipt and capacity reservation.
causal_mechanism: The retry path checked implementation tasklet readiness before selecting the successor action type, so review-only readiness was never considered.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A retry of a polymorphic dispatch was gated by one lifecycle phase's readiness predicate.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: A plan can legitimately leave implementation readiness and enter review readiness while the original host creation remains unresolved.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Retry eligibility and successor type must agree on the same current, phase-specific readiness predicate without weakening original identity fencing.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Choose the existing implementation predicate or the review predicate; require a safe original idle pair for review and issue REVIEW_WORKER for its exact sprint while preserving the original STARTED receipt.

applicability_conditions: Original unprovisioned STARTED creation with unknown outcome
Current plan is review-ready without runnable implementation tasklets
Fresh complete host observation and a safe original idle campaign pair
confirmation_evidence: The focused regression failed with CAMPAIGN_DISPATCH_NOT_READY before the phase-specific retry change and passes after it.
regression_proofs: tests/campaign-orchestration.test.js: fenced retry reuses an original idle pair for review when implementation readiness became review-only
